android.desc:
The Brazilian CNH app is the evolution of the Digital Traffic Wallet (CDT), which started as the Digital CNH. With the app, you can access your digital documents - National Driver's License (CNH) and Vehicle Registration and Licensing Certificate (CRLV) - in a practical and secure way, directly from your cell phone.

In addition, those who are not yet licensed can start the process of obtaining their First Driver's License through the app itself, making everything simpler and more accessible.

The Digital CNH and the Digital CRLV are the digital versions of the National Driver's License (CNH) and the Vehicle Registration and Licensing Certificate (CRLV) with the same legal value as their respective printed versions.

The digital versions offer additional advantages that provide greater mobility, practicality and convenience through:

- Ease of sharing information (export to PDF with digital signature in the ICP-Brasil standard with legal validity according to MP 2.200-2/2001). This avoids printing and/or scanning documents, as well as eliminating the need for notarization;

- Have your authenticity, reliability, and integrity easily validated through the Vio app. To do this, simply download the Vio app and point the reader at the QR Code of your digital document.

For more information, visit:

Frequently Asked Questions:

https://portalservicos.senatran.serpro.gov.br/#/ajuda/faq/cnh-do-brasil

quotes.text:
> in their wallet

Playing devil's advocate: what wallet? As more and more functionality is moved to the smartphone, the less reason to carry a wallet there is. A smartphone can already replace credit cards (Google Pay and similar), cash (several per-country payment systems, the one for my country will be released in a couple of months), and even the driving license! (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=br.gov.serpro.cnhe)

In a more humorous note, I've seen many people use their cell phone as their wallet... by putting their identity card and cash inside the aftermarket cell phone cover on the back of the phone.
